source: family CWE lists of reports/DIVERSITY-AND-PATTERNS-20261027.md (section 3.3); file upload merged into the main pipeline's path traversal (excluded here), template injection merged into code injection

patterns.name: Open redirect
patterns.other_places_hint: every place that issues a redirect or builds a return URL: login/logout flows, OAuth/SSO callbacks, framework redirect helpers, error and 'next' parameters, and URL forms a validator may read differently from the browser (protocol-relative, backslash, userinfo, encoded).

patterns.name: CSRF / CORS / origin
patterns.other_places_hint: every state-changing route and transport, not only the reported one: alternate request pipelines, WebSocket upgrades, JSON vs form endpoints, method overrides, and every origin/CORS check (wildcards, null origin, subdomain and suffix matching).

patterns.name: XSS / sanitiser
patterns.other_places_hint: every output context and every renderer: other templates, markdown/rich-text paths, attribute vs element vs URL contexts, sanitiser allow-lists, and parser differentials between the sanitiser and the browser.

patterns.name: SQL / NoSQL / query injection
patterns.other_places_hint: every query builder and raw-query path, other database dialects and their comment/quoting grammar, ORDER BY / identifier positions, and NoSQL operator objects arriving through other parsers.

patterns.name: OS command / argument injection
patterns.other_places_hint: every place that builds a command or argument list: other subcommands, option injection through values starting with '-', shell vs exec paths, and platform-specific branches.

patterns.name: Code / template / expression injection
patterns.other_places_hint: every place that evaluates or compiles user-influenced text: other template engines or sandboxes, expression languages, code generators, and denylists that miss equivalent forms.

patterns.name: Header / CRLF / log injection
patterns.other_places_hint: every point that emits headers, mail headers or log lines with user data: other response helpers, proxies, mailers and structured vs plain log sinks.

patterns.name: XXE / XML entities
patterns.other_places_hint: every XML parser factory and wrapper in the codebase (DOM, SAX, StAX, XSLT, schema validation, XPath, transformers) and every format that is XML underneath (SVG, Office, XMP, SOAP).

patterns.name: Input validation / canonicalisation
patterns.other_places_hint: every route that accepts the same value and every spelling of it: case, Unicode and encoding normalisation, numeric forms, and consumers that canonicalise later than the check.

patterns.name: Prototype pollution / mass assignment
patterns.other_places_hint: every merge, clone, set-by-path, deserialise and bind helper, and every model binder or update path that copies caller-supplied keys onto objects.

patterns.name: Authentication / session
patterns.other_places_hint: every login, token, session and identity-parsing path: alternate auth methods, API vs UI routes, header or identity canonicalisation, session fixation and logout or expiry paths.

patterns.name: Signature / certificate verification
patterns.other_places_hint: every verification path: each algorithm, key source, and signed element; detached vs embedded signatures; certificate-chain and hostname checks; and code that falls back to 'no verification' on error.

patterns.name: Crypto misuse / weak randomness
patterns.other_places_hint: every mode, configuration and key/IV/nonce source for the same guarantee, other places randomness is generated, and components that send or store data around the crypto layer.

patterns.name: Secrets in logs or errors
patterns.other_places_hint: every place a secret can leak: other log statements, error messages and stack traces, debug endpoints, telemetry or metrics, serialised objects and URLs that carry credentials.

patterns.name: Deserialization
patterns.other_places_hint: every deserialisation entry point and format: polymorphic type handling, nested and default typing, YAML/XML/binary front ends, caches, message queues and RPC paths that reach the same unmarshaller.

patterns.name: Supply chain / untrusted code loading
patterns.other_places_hint: every place code, plugins, models or packages are fetched or loaded: other download paths, update channels, search paths, integrity or signature checks and their fallbacks.

patterns.name: Request smuggling / parser differential
patterns.other_places_hint: every pair of parsers that must agree on one message: front end vs back end, header folding, duplicate or conflicting length and transfer-encoding fields, trailers and continuation frames.

patterns.name: Race / TOCTOU
patterns.other_places_hint: every check-then-use pair on the same resource: other file operations, temp-file and link handling, permission checks done before the operation, and concurrent state updates.

patterns.name: ReDoS
patterns.other_places_hint: every regular expression applied to the same untrusted input, other copies of the same pattern idiom elsewhere in the codebase, and parsers that call them in a loop.

patterns.name: Algorithmic / resource-exhaustion DoS
patterns.other_places_hint: every loop, recursion or allocation driven by input size or nesting: other parsers and decoders for the same format, limits enforced in one path but not another, and quadratic merges.

patterns.name: Memory safety (native)
patterns.other_places_hint: every copy, index and length computation on the same buffer or structure: other decoders for the same format, sibling functions sharing the size arithmetic, and error paths that free or reuse memory.

patterns.name: Integer overflow / numeric
patterns.other_places_hint: every size, offset and count computed from input: other arithmetic on the same fields, narrowing casts, signed/unsigned mixes, and allocations sized from those values.
